summary: 9 film announcements, 6 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Leprechaun
film.announcement: New horror film in development from Lionsgate with writers Patrick Melton and Marcus Dunstan attached.

film.title: The Legend of Zelda
film.announcement: Lydia Peckham cast in the film adaptation of The Legend of Zelda.

film.title: Drifter
film.talent: Kate Beckinsale, Dermot Mulroney, Robert Knepper, Sticky Fingaz
film.announcement: Action-thriller film casts Kate Beckinsale, Dermot Mulroney, Robert Knepper and rapper Sticky Fingaz in leading roles.

film.title: The Gallerist
film.announcement: MRC comedy starring Jenna Ortega and Natalie Portman acquired by Roadside Attractions and Vertical for U.S. distribution.

film.title: Nickels
film.announcement: Supernatural drama sets fall theatrical and PVOD release dates through Briarcliff Entertainment.

film.title: Dedicated to Morris Burke
film.announcement: Da'Vine Joy Randolph cast to star in indie dark comedy directed by Will Ropp.

film.title: Descendants: Hidden Heroes
film.announcement: Disney expands Descendants universe with new film following children of sidekicks from Aladdin, The Emperor's New Groove and more.

film.title: Star Trek 60th Anniversary Documentary
film.announcement: 60th anniversary Star Trek documentary featuring William Shatner coming to Regal Cinemas in October.

film.title: Wonka 2
film.announcement: Warner Bros. and screenwriter clarify that Wonka 2 is not delayed indefinitely.

tv.title: Sherlock's Secretary
tv.announcement: Andy Berman, creator of Psych, eyeing return to USA Network with procedural series Sherlock's Secretary in development.

tv.title: Heated Rivalry
tv.announcement: Season 2 casts Justice Smith as Harris and Charlie Gillespie as Troy with debut confirmed for Spring 2027.

tv.title: New York Yankees Drama Series
tv.talent: Jason Bateman (producer via Aggregate Films), Josh Wakely
tv.announcement: Netflix developing Yankees drama series from Jason Bateman's Aggregate Films, Josh Wakely and MLB.

tv.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives
tv.announcement: Series lands 20-episode renewal for additional episodes following Taylor Frankie Paul drama.
